desc:
🎣 Fishing Trip is a co-op fishing adventure! Sail out with your crew, reel in rare fish and dodge rocks, icebergs and whirlpools. How far out will you go?

🐙 Reel in raid bosses like the Apex Tuna, the King Goldfish and the Kraken. Alone, if you dare!

🐟 Catch 48 fish across 6 zones, from the Shallows to the Sunken Ruins
🌅 Sail through sunsets, starry nights and rain for rare mutations
⛵ Take the wheel and steer your boat past the dangers
🔨 Patch cracks with your hammer to keep the trip going
🛥️ Upgrade 4 boats through 5 tiers each and unlock 15 rods
💰 Keep every fish you catch, even if the boat goes down

📱 Plays on phone, tablet, PC and console
👍 Like and favorite to get new fish and boats first!
